verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents its own REST API, which can reach 'any existing object' in your account and returns standard JSON (JSON API spec), with a published OpenAPI 3.0 definition. That gives programmatic retrieval of your data in an open format, but nothing documents a dedicated bulk export or offboarding path, so getting everything out means scripting against the endpoints. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk full-account export, confirmation that every data type (policies, evidence files, audit history) is exportable, file-level formats such as CSV or PDF, data-portability or offboarding guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
